commands.description: Clone and build Havoc C2 from source on Ubuntu 22.04.
commands.command:
git clone https://github.com/HavocFramework/Havoc.git
cd Havoc
sudo apt install -y build-essential cmake mingw-w64 libssl-dev libz-dev \
  python3-dev libexpat1-dev git

# Build teamserver:
cd teamserver && go mod download
go build -o teamserver . && mv teamserver ../

# Build client UI:
cd ../client
npm install && npm run build

commands.description: Install Havoc via Docker (recommended for clean deployment).

docker-compose up --build

commands.description: Configure HTTPS listener via teamserver YAML (infrastructure-as-code).
commands.command:
Listeners:
  - Name: prod-https
    Protocol: Https
    Host: {c2_server}
    Port: 443
    Secure: true
    UserAgent: "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
    Uris:
      - /updates/
      - /cdn/
      - /api/v1/
    Headers:
      - "Cache-Control: no-cache"
      - "Accept-Language: en-US"
    Hosts:
      - {c2_domain}
